text: I'm Dr. Agent, and I'm here to help. To begin, have you had any fever, blood in your stool, or recent travel? REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Hemoglobin: 13 g/dL, Total_Count_WBC: 13,400/mm3, Differential_Count: Neutrophils 80%, Lymphocytes 15%, Monocytes 5%

speaker: Doctor
text: The CBC shows mild leukocytosis with neutrophilia, suggesting an inflammatory or infectious process. Have you experienced any abdominal pain, nausea, or vomiting alongside your diarrhea? REQUEST TEST: Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text: That's good news regarding your basic metabolic profile. To narrow down the cause, have you noticed any significant weight loss or night sweats, and do you have any history of recent antibiotic use? REQUEST TEST: Stool_Culture_and_Sensitivity; REQUEST TEST: C difficile_Toxidetection

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Stool_Culture: Pending, C_difficile_Toxin: Not specified

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the update; since stool culture is pending, I need to clarify your symptoms further. Have you noticed any blood or mucus in your stool, and does the diarrhea improve after a bowel movement? REQUEST TEST: C-reactive_Protein (CRP); REQUEST TEST: Fecal_Lipase

speaker: Doctor
text: With normal inflammatory markers and lipase, and no evidence of *C. difficile* yet, did your diarrhea begin suddenly after eating a specific food, and has anyone around you been sick? REQUEST TEST: O&P (Ova and Parasite)

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Viral Gastroenteritis (likely Norovirus or Rotavirus).
